items.title: Uzbekistan bans park/hospital land privatization, targets 30% greenery
items.one_liner: Uzbekistan moves to ban the privatization of public land and sets a 30% urban greenery target.
items.why: Provides a relevant Central Asian / Global South regulatory benchmark for protecting urban nature and green spaces.
items.action: Track legislative updates on the 30% greenery target to compare with Kabul's ecological planning.

items.title: Syntropic infrastructure for regenerative urban metabolic reorganization
items.one_liner: New research in Nature explores syntropic infrastructure for regenerative urban metabolic reorganization.
items.why: Provides advanced conceptual models for urban metabolism and nature-based infrastructure design.
items.action: Read the Nature article to evaluate how syntropic principles apply to semi-arid urban systems.

items.title: $7.6m Urban Resilience Facility launches at COP31
items.one_liner: A $7.6 million Urban Resilience Facility was launched at the COP31 climate conference.
items.why: Highlights funding mechanisms and international financial flows targeted at urban resilience in the Global South.
items.action: Investigate grant criteria for the Urban Resilience Facility to understand financing for resilience projects.

items.title: Rising preterm births in Bangladesh linked to extreme heat
items.one_liner: Research links extreme heat exposure to a rise in preterm births in Bangladesh.
items.why: Connects extreme heat to human health impacts in the Global South, aiding the study of urban heat mitigation benefits.
items.action: Read the study to incorporate health vulnerabilities into local ecosystem service assessments.

items.title: Green transition becomes new growth driver for Ho Chi Minh City
items.one_liner: Ho Chi Minh City focuses on a green transition as a new engine for urban growth.
items.why: Illustrates Global South urban policy shifts toward sustainability and green infrastructure integration.
items.action: Examine the city's strategic framework for insights on green-blue infrastructure planning.

items.title: COP31 focuses on climate resilience and adaptation finance
items.one_liner: The COP31 climate conference enters its final week focusing on climate resilience and adaptation finance.
items.why: Informs international policy trends regarding climate adaptation funding for vulnerable urban contexts.
items.action: Review COP31 outcome documents related to urban adaptation and resilience frameworks.

items.title: Indonesia pushes marine ecosystem-based climate solutions at COP31
items.one_liner: Indonesia highlights marine ecosystem-based climate solutions during negotiations at COP31.
items.why: Demonstrates ecosystem-based adaptation strategies applied by a major Global South nation.
items.action: Review Indonesia's ecosystem-based proposals for methodological transferability to terrestrial contexts.
